enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Greater Giant Bane: A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Giants, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +4 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 3 to 18 points of damage against the foe.
